repository_tests.count_basis: Rust source definitions and successful Vitest JSON report

cases.threat: An arbitrary account submits a payroll authorization request.
cases.protection: Only the configured agent account may call request_payment.

cases.threat: A non-owner invokes the privileged security probe and appends misleading evidence.
cases.protection: The security probe is owner-only and fails before changing audit state.

cases.threat: A notification API caller impersonates a payroll owner.
cases.protection: Authorization is checked against the owner returned by the payroll contract.
cases.test: accepts only the owner returned by the payroll contract

cases.threat: A shared payroll agent starts with a Full Access key that can invoke owner methods.
cases.protection: Runtime access-key verification rejects Full Access and over-broad Function Call permissions.
cases.test: rejects Full Access keys without an override

cases.threat: The scheduler reuses one contract credential for another payroll contract.
cases.protection: Credentials are resolved by receiver and missing contract entries fail closed.
cases.test: fails closed when a credential file omits a discovered contract

cases.threat: A full-access settlement signer reuses the payroll agent account and weakens the restricted-key claim.
cases.protection: Startup rejects any settlement account that overlaps a payroll authorization account.
cases.test: rejects a settlement signer that reuses a payroll agent account

cases.threat: The agent targets a recipient that the owner never approved.
cases.protection: Unknown recipient commitments are rejected on-chain.

cases.threat: The agent pays a recipient after the owner suspends them.
cases.protection: Suspended recipients cannot receive an authorization.

cases.threat: A single payment exceeds the global per-payment ceiling.
cases.protection: The contract rejects the request before spend state changes.

cases.threat: A recipient-specific cap is bypassed while the global limit still permits payment.
cases.protection: The recipient cap is independently enforced.

cases.threat: Several individually valid requests exceed the daily treasury limit.
cases.protection: Cumulative daily spend is checked before approval.

cases.threat: A compromised agent continues payroll after the owner pauses the contract.
cases.protection: The pause switch is evaluated before payment policy.

cases.threat: The agent redirects an approved recipient to another chain or token.
cases.protection: The destination route must exactly match owner-approved recipient policy.

cases.threat: A native payment is sent to the worker identity wallet instead of the configured payout destination.
cases.protection: Native settlement uses the validated destination address from the payroll route.
cases.test: uses the configured native payout destination instead of the worker identity wallet

cases.threat: The contract consumes policy capacity before a known-unavailable delivery route is checked.
cases.protection: Settlement preflight runs before request_payment and rejects missing signer or unsupported routes.
cases.test: does not consume authorization when settlement preflight fails

cases.threat: The agent requests a scheduled payment before it is due.
cases.protection: The contract rejects early scheduled requests.

cases.threat: A manual milestone is executed repeatedly under the same milestone ID.
cases.protection: Stable milestone IDs trigger at most once.
cases.test: triggers a milestone once per stable milestone ID

cases.threat: A filled cross-chain intent is submitted a second time after restart or polling.
cases.protection: Filled intents are alerted and removed without resubmission.
cases.test: alerts and removes a filled intent without submitting it again

cases.threat: The same finalized notification event is delivered repeatedly.
cases.protection: Processed events are deduplicated in persistent state.
cases.test: deduplicates processed transaction and authorization events

cases.threat: Malformed or attacker-controlled destination data is written to the private payroll plan.
cases.protection: Route inputs are validated before persistence.
cases.test: rejects malformed routes before writing a plan

cases.threat: A private-plan sync response leaks salary or destination details.
cases.protection: The plan is persisted but excluded from the API response.
cases.test: syncs a validated private plan without exposing it through the response

cases.threat: Daily-spend arithmetic wraps at the u128 boundary and permits excess payment.
cases.protection: Overflow is detected and rejected by the pure rule evaluator.

cases.threat: The audit counter exhausts mid-probe and leaves partial or misleading evidence.
cases.protection: Capacity is checked before any of the five audit records are written.

limitations: This report is generated from deterministic repository tests; it is not an independent third-party audit.
The deployed product is testnet-only and must not custody mainnet funds.
Standard NEAR function-call arguments and chain metadata remain public even when public audit entries omit salary and recipient fields.
Cross-chain settlement correctness depends on external solver and destination-chain behavior that unit tests cannot fully prove.
The five browser-triggered contract probes are a demonstration layer. The CI suites and source-linked cases below are the primary reproducible evidence.
